preconditions.description: The lengths of the sequences for both pieces (m1 and m2) are between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum steps required.

postconditions.description: The sequences for both pieces are valid and contain nodes within the tree's node range.
